calendar_invites.name: Calendar invitations
turnOn: Registration confirmation emails carry a calendar invitation.
The event page shows calendar links after signing up.
stops: New confirmation emails have no calendar invitation and the calendar links are hidden.
keeps: Invitations already sent stay in recipients' calendars.

confetti.name: Confetti
turnOn: Confetti is shown after an event or a registration has been created, except to users who prefer reduced motion.
keeps: Creating events and registrations works as before.

event_templates.name: Event templates
turnOn: The quotas and questions tabs of the event form offer templates and ready-made quotas and questions.
stops: The template selectors are hidden and the tabs show the plain lists.
keeps: Quotas and questions added from a template stay on their events.

form_preview.name: Registration form preview
turnOn: The event form gets a Preview tab that shows the registration form as registrants see it.
keeps: Nothing is ever submitted from the preview, so no data changes.

keycloak_names.name: Names from Keycloak
turnOn: The registration form fills in the first and last name stored from Keycloak.
Without them, it fills in a display name only when it has at most two words.
stops: The registration form goes back to splitting the display name into first and last name.
keeps: First and last names are still stored at every Keycloak login.
Registrations already made keep their names.

mcp_server.name: MCP server
turnOn: The MCP server answers at /mcp: AI assistants signed in through Keycloak can browse events and register, and admins can create draft events.
stops: /mcp and its OAuth discovery paths answer 404.
keeps: Events and registrations made through MCP are kept.

payments.name: Payments
turnOn: Admins can price quotas and choose when registrants pay.
Registrants of paid quotas pay through Stripe Checkout, and payment emails and reminders are sent.
Admins get the payment tools for their events.
stops: Prices and payment settings are hidden and cannot be set, and paying is blocked.
No new payment emails or reminders are sent.
keeps: Payments already made stay recorded and are shown to registrants.
Refunds and Stripe payment notifications keep working.

prefill_answers.name: Remembered registration answers
turnOn: Admins can mark a text question as asking for the registrant's Telegram handle or dietary restrictions.
The registration form prefills those answers from the user's saved registration details, and offers to remember new answers.
The profile settings page shows the registration details for editing.
stops: Answers are no longer prefilled and the registration form no longer offers to remember them.
Registration details can no longer be saved or edited.
keeps: Questions keep their Telegram or dietary restriction marking and work as ordinary text questions.
Users can still delete the registration details they saved.

registration_reminders.name: Registration reminders
turnOn: The event page offers a reminder before registration opens.
The settings get a reminders page with the user's reminders and reminder settings.
Reminder emails are sent before registration opens.
stops: The reminder button, the reminders page and its menu links are hidden.
No reminders are sent. A reminder that falls due while the flag is off is not sent later.
keeps: Saved reminders and reminder settings are kept.

ribbon_text.name: Ribbon text
turnOn: The event form shows ribbon text inputs for highlighted events.
Event cards show the custom ribbon text.
stops: Event cards show the default ribbon text and the event form hides the inputs.
keeps: Stored ribbon texts are kept, also when an event is saved.

telegram_reminders.name: Telegram reminders
turnOn: Users can link a Telegram account and choose Telegram for their reminders.
Reminders also go out through the Telegram bot.
stops: Telegram can no longer be linked or chosen, and no reminders go out through Telegram.

typed_time_input.name: Typed times
turnOn: The event form uses typed hour, minute and second boxes for the event and registration times.
Clicking a day in the calendar fills in default times.
stops: The event form goes back to the time scroll columns.
keeps: Saved event and registration times stay as they are.
